For the effect of pipemidic acid on the clearance of xanthines, see under Caffeine, p.1117, and Theophylline, p.1143. Porphyria. Pipemidic acid is considered to be unsafe in patients with porphyria because it has been shown to be porphyrinogenic in in-vitro systems.
